candidate_integrity_contract.selection_order: lowest source rank then candidate_id among non-colliding candidates

metric_implementation_contract.T3_spearman: scipy.stats.spearmanr with average ranks for ties

amendment_reason: A completion audit found one template training candidate identical to its observed parent product, found that the prior custom average-precision, Spearman and NDCG implementations did not use standard tie handling, and found that the earlier 256-token setting truncated candidate products. Parent-positive collisions are label-invalid and are excluded before source selection. Cross-source duplicate candidates are retained and reported because independent methods may converge on the same structure. Primary AUPRC and secondary rank metrics now use standard sklearn/SciPy implementations with explicit tie semantics. The checkpoint-native 512-token limit is frozen and formal runs fail if any train-arm, validation or test segment would be truncated.
freeze_statement: This corrected reanalysis plan was frozen after the training-manifest integrity finding and before the corrected GPU run. The original test outcomes had already been observed. The endpoint, thresholds, comparison family, non-inferiority margin, source aliases, seed count and inferential procedure are unchanged. This run is a corrected reanalysis, not a new blind confirmation.
